title: Managerial Functions and Designated Persons
summary: How the management company organises its managerial functions, the substance and time commitment the authority expects, and how the board oversees the people who perform them.
contentGaps: Written as part of a programme: Aim and Purpose is the module's one-line description; audience, prior knowledge and core reading come from the programme

sections.Aim and Purpose: How the management company organises its managerial functions, the substance and time commitment the authority expects, and how the board oversees the people who perform them.
Learning Objectives: Explain the managerial functions and how they are allocated
Assess substance, resourcing and time commitment of designated persons
Evaluate reporting from designated persons to the board
Syllabus: Core managerial functions: investment, risk, distribution, operations and compliance
Allocation, capability and time commitment of designated persons
Substance requirements and avoiding letterbox arrangements
Designated persons' reporting and the board's monitoring plan
Intended Audience: Independent and non-executive directors of investment funds and fund management companies
Executive directors, designated persons and conducting officers of fund management companies
Company secretaries, governance leads and service provider relationship managers supporting fund boards
sections.Useful Prior Knowledge and Experience: Some experience of investment funds or asset management is helpful. No prior board experience is required.
Core Reading: IOSCO, Examination of Governance for Collective Investment Schemes (2006–2007)
IOSCO, Principles for the Valuation of Collective Investment Schemes (2013)
IOSCO, Recommendations for Liquidity Risk Management for Collective Investment Schemes (2018)

modules.title: Delegation and Oversight of the Investment Manager
Overseeing the Administrator, Depositary and Distributors
Fees, Costs and Value for Investors
Regulatory Engagement and Board Effectiveness Reviews
Emerging Issues: AI, ESG and Tokenised Funds

related.title: Alternative Investments for Fund Directors
related.summary: An eight-module programme explaining hedge fund, private markets, real asset, structured and digital asset strategies to fund directors, with board questions on valuation, liquidity and fees.

related.title: Board Oversight of Fund Operations and Service Providers
related.summary: A ten-module programme giving fund directors the tools to oversee fund operations and service providers, from NAV production and custody to errors and resilience.

related.title: Fund Board Governance Toolkit: A Risk-Based Oversight Workshop
related.summary: A six-module practical workshop giving fund directors a risk-based governance toolkit, from skills matrices to escalation triggers, and a draft oversight plan for their own board.
